checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: Original waveform at 0 through 90 ns, initial unknown output, and all 64 known-input transitions

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
The original waveform specifies only fully unknown and known inputs; partially unknown inputs are not specified.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation is a combinational case lookup for the eight waveform values, with an unknown default. No RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent testbench replays original timestamps using delta-cycle settling and additionally checks every known-input transition. No testbench revisions.
